The Conversation
About

The Conversation brings AI researchers, content creators, journalists, filmmakers, and funders into one room to close the gap between what's happening inside AI and what the public actually understands.

We're living through the most consequential technological shift in human history, and most people still don't have a way to make sense of it. The people who shape public understanding, the creators, storytellers, and journalists translating frontier research for the rest of the world, rarely sit in the same room as the researchers doing the work.

Our vision is simple: put those two worlds in direct conversation. Over two days, we bring them together to build the relationships, shared language, and mutual trust needed to direct public attention toward what actually matters about AI's impact on society.

FAQ

What is The Conversation?
A curated gathering for the people shaping how the world understands AI: researchers, creators, journalists, filmmakers, policymakers, and funders. The first edition was a 150-person invite-only evening at Lighthaven in Berkeley in March 2026.
When is the next edition?
Dates will be announced soon. Venue and lineup will be shared with the updates list first — sign up above to hear first.
How do I attend?
Sign up for updates above. Tickets and invitations open in waves, and the list hears first.
Can I speak or showcase work?
Yes. Reach out at akshyae@framefellowship.com with what you'd bring.
Who is behind this?
The Conversation is a self-standing project from the team behind Frame, the San Francisco accelerator for the next generation of AI communicators.
Press, partnerships, or sponsorship?
Email akshyae@framefellowship.com. Conversations for the October edition are open now.
